events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first music video.

angles.name: MTVMoments
angles.copy: Remember the day the music video changed everything? MTV burst onto our screens in '81, kicking off with The Buggles. Did video really kill the radio star, though?

events.title: Oasis release Definitely Maybe
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album, 'Definitely Maybe', in 1994.

angles.name: OasisAnniversary
angles.copy: 32 years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music forever. What's your favourite track from the album that started it all?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened its gates on this day in 1969.

angles.name: WoodstockSpirit
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on.

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, on this day in 1977.

angles.name: RememberingTheKing
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His legacy as the King of Rock and Roll remains unmatched, continuing to inspire generations.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: HappyBirthdayChrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! From 'Brass in Pocket' to 'Don't Get Me Wrong', her voice and style are unmistakable.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: HappyBirthdayLiam
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The swagger, the voice, the tunes. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon released Imagine (UK single)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: ImagineAnniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. A song that still resonates with hope and peace.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: 007Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's enduring legacy since Dr. No premiered in '62. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: RememberingLennon
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: HappyBirthdayJohnCleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the iconic John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy legend.
